Welcome to Building Multigenerational Health: From Fertility to Menopause—an exclusive event designed to rewrite the narrative of a woman’s life cycle. Whether you are navigating future fertility, balancing the beautiful chaos of motherhood, or stepping into the radiant wisdom of menopause, this afternoon is for you. We are bridging cutting-edge longevity science with a supportive lifestyle community to help you program your body for lifelong vitality.  
🎤 Featured Speaker: Dr. Anna Maria Clement, PhD, LN • The Authority on Longevity: As the world-renowned Co-Director of Hippocrates Wellness, Dr. Anna Maria Clement is a global pioneer in lifestyle medicine and progressive nutrition. • Mastering Your Biology: Backed by over 40 years of international clinical experience, she brings the deep biochemical research needed to navigate major female milestones. • Cellular Youth: From maximizing fertility to thriving through menopause, she will show you exactly how to unlock lifelong hormonal harmony and lasting energy. 👰 Hosted By: Lillianna Haas • The Keeper of Life's Beginnings: Lillianna Haas is the visionary owner and operator of Truly Forever Bridal, Florida’s premier destination for celebrating family milestones. • Creating a Sanctuary: Famous for cultivating empowering environments where women feel seen and celebrated, Lillianna opens her doors to expand her mission—ensuring a woman's radiant confidence shines decades aftershe walks down the aisle.   🎬 Produced By: Caroline Cea Bryan • The Architect of the Experience: Caroline Bryan is a premier Lifestyle Medicine Expert who has collaborated with Hippocrates Wellness for nearly two decades. • Bridging Vision & Action: Serving as the event’s executive producer and a Personal Health Designer, Caroline seamlessly connects clinical wellness with daily lifestyle habits to make legacy health an actionable reality.
